name: Angela
source:
Abandoned her religion when her parents forced her to marry a man she didn't love.

Her shapely body attracts the attention of all men, and she is fully aware of it.

Despite her reputation as a libertine, Angela is more well-behaved than people think.

She has abandoned her family's religion, but she retains some faith and spirituality without completely converting to a secular and skeptical life.

She has lived in Central America for some years, near where Honeymoon Island is located.
